description: Audit log endpoints + User/Role management API + Security hardening sweep (T21-T30): Full AuditService with hash-chain verification endpoint, paginated audit read endpoint, UserService with token issuance and role management, and comprehensive security hardening tests for all 10 STRIDE threat items and all RBAC/ACL boundaries. Independent of FEAT-003 at the feature level but shares entities — implement after FEAT-003 since CryptoService uses AuditService.
steps: Finalize g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\AuditService.java (already stubbed in FEAT-003 — verify hash-chain logic is complete): appendRecord(AuditAction, UUID keyId, AuditOutcome, HsmPrincipal): compute chainHash = SHA-256 of '|'-delimited string: prevChainHash | sequenceNumber | recordedAt (ISO-8601 nanoseconds) | principalId (or 'SYSTEM') | action | keyId (or 'null') | outcome. prevChainHash for first record = 64-char hex zero string. Load prev via AuditRecordRepository.findTopByOrderBySequenceNumberDesc(). PROPAGATION.REQUIRED for SUCCESS, PROPAGATION.REQUIRES_NEW for DENIED/ERROR. getRecords(Pageable pageable, Instant from, Instant to): @PreAuthorize("hasRole('AUDITOR')"); call AuditRecordRepository.findByRecordedAtBetween; also append AUDIT_READ record. verifyChain(): load all records ordered by sequenceNumber ASC; re-compute hash for each; return AuditVerifyResult.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\AuditRecordDto.java: record with long sequenceNumber, UUID id, Instant recordedAt, UUID principalId, AuditAction action, UUID keyId, AuditOutcome outcome, String chainHash.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\AuditPageResponse.java: record with int page, int size, long totalElements, List<AuditRecordDto> records.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\AuditVerifyResult.java: record with boolean valid, long recordCount, Long firstTamperedSequence (nullable), Instant verifiedAt.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\controller\AuditController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/audit"). GET / (params: page, size, from Instant, to Instant) → auditService.getRecords; return AuditPageResponse 200. GET /verify → auditService.verifyChain; return AuditVerifyResult 200. @PreAuthorize("hasRole('AUDITOR')") on each method (belt-and-suspenders with service-level @PreAuthorize). @Operation/@ApiResponse annotations.

Write unit tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\service\AuditServiceTest.java: firstRecordUsesZeroHash, consecutiveRecordsFormValidChain, chainHashIsDetError (modify one field → hash changes), deniedOperationIsAuditedEvenWhenPrimaryTxRollsBack (mock repo, verify REQUIRES_NEW propagation called for DENIED outcome).

Write integration tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\controller\AuditControllerIT.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: auditorCanReadLog, appClientCannotReadLog @Tag("security"), paginationWorksCorrectly, dateRangeFilterReturnsCorrectRecords, auditReadEventIsItselfAudited, verifyIntactLogReturnsValid, verifyTamperedRecordDetected (update chain_hash in DB directly, then GET /audit/verify → valid=false), verifyTamperedFieldDetected (update action field in DB, GET /audit/verify → valid=false, firstTamperedSequence set), verifyEmptyLogReturnsValid.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\CreateUserRequest.java: record with @NotBlank String username, @NotNull UserRole role.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\CreateUserResponse.java: record with UUID id, String username, UserRole role, String token, String warning.
Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\dto\UserDto.java: record with UUID id, String username, UserRole role, Instant createdAt, boolean enabled. NO tokenHash.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\service\UserService.java: @Service @Transactional. Inject HsmUserRepository, TokenService, AuditService. createUser(CreateUserRequest, HsmPrincipal caller) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"). Steps: check username uniqueness (throw KeyAlreadyExistsException — or better create UserAlreadyExistsException extends HsmException → 409); generate plain token via TokenService.generateToken(); hash via TokenService.hashToken(); also compute token_prefix (first 16 chars of plain token) for fast lookup; persist HsmUser(username, tokenHash, tokenPrefix, role, enabled=true); append audit USER_CREATE; return CreateUserResponse including plain token (shown once — do NOT store plain token). listUsers(HsmPrincipal caller) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"); return List<UserDto> (no tokens). assignRole(UUID userId, UserRole newRole, HsmPrincipal caller) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"); update user.role; audit ROLE_ASSIGN. revokeRole — user.role set to null is not clean; model is single-role per user (design); revokeRole sets enabled=false or removes role. disableUser(UUID userId, HsmPrincipal caller) — @PreAuthorize("hasRole('ADMIN')"); set enabled=false; audit USER_DISABLE. Note: the design has one role per user; role assignment replaces the existing role; this is consistent with the 4-role model.

Create g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\controller\UserController.java: @RestController @RequestMapping("/api/v1/users"). POST / → createUser 201; GET / → listUsers 200; DELETE /{id} → disableUser 200; POST /{id}/roles/{role} → assignRole 200; DELETE /{id}/roles/{role} → revokeRole 200. @Operation/@ApiResponse annotations.

Update g:\hsm\src\main\java\com\example\hsm\security\TokenAuthenticationFilter.java: add fast-lookup by token_prefix. Add HsmUserRepository.findByTokenPrefix(String) Optional<HsmUser>. In filter: extract prefix from incoming token (first 16 chars), look up by prefix, if found verify full hash; if no match return 401. Also check user.enabled — disabled user → 401 same generic message.

Add Flyway migration g:\hsm\src\main\resources\db\migration\V6__add_token_prefix.sql: ALTER TABLE hsm_users ADD COLUMN token_prefix VARCHAR(16); CREATE INDEX idx_users_token_prefix ON hsm_users(token_prefix);

Write integration tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\controller\UserControllerIT.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: adminCreatesUserAndReceivesOneTimeToken, tokenIsShownOnce (GET /users does not return token), createdTokenCanAuthenticateImmediately, nonAdminCannotCreateUser @Tag("security"), duplicateUsernameReturns409, adminAssignsRole, adminRevokesRole (user cannot use revoked-role endpoints), adminDisablesUser (disabled user token returns 401), nonAdminCannotRevokeRole @Tag("security").

Write security hardening tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\security\AuthenticationServiceTest.java @Tag("security"): falseTokenIsRejected, truncatedTokenReturns401, tokenForDisabledUserReturns401, noTokenReturns401, emptyBearerReturns401. Assert all 401 responses have IDENTICAL body (no oracle distinguishing bad-token vs unknown-user).

Write security hardening tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\security\AuditIntegrityTest.java @Tag("security"): tamperedRecordIsDetected (same as AuditControllerIT#verifyTamperedRecordDetected — move here or reference), insertedRecordIsDetected (insert record with forged hash into DB → verifyChain returns false), deletedRecordIsDetected (delete a middle record → verifyChain returns false).

Write security hardening tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\security\CryptoServiceIT.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest @Tag("security"): tamperedStoredDekCausesDecryptionFailure (use TestEntityManager or JDBC to flip a byte in hsm_keys.wrapped_dek, then call POST /crypto/decrypt → expect 400).

Write RBAC sweep tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\security\RbacEnforcementTest.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: all @Tag("security"): appClientCannotGenerateKey, appClientCannotRotateKey, appClientCannotDestroyKey, appClientCannotGrantAcl, cryptoOfficerCannotEncrypt, cryptoOfficerCannotReadAuditLog, adminCannotGenerateKey, adminCannotEncrypt, auditorCannotGenerateKey, auditorCannotEncrypt.

Write ACL enforcement tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\security\AclEnforcementTest.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: all @Tag("security"): appClientWithoutAclIsRejected (AppClient calls encrypt with no ACL → 403), appClientAfterAclRevocationIsRejected (grant then revoke ACL, then call encrypt → 403).

Write key state guard tests g:\hsm\src\test\java\com\example\hsm\security\KeyStateGuardTest.java extends AbstractIntegrationTest: all @Tag("security"): disabledKeyRejectsEncrypt, disabledKeyRejectsSign, destroyedKeyRejectsAllCryptoOps (encrypt/decrypt/sign/verify → all 410/422), destroyedKeyRejectsDisable, destroyedKeyRejectsRotate.
Run mvn --batch-mode verify to confirm all FEAT-004 tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: mvn --batch-mode verify passes with BUILD SUCCESS
AuditControllerIT: all 9 tests pass including verifyTamperedRecordDetected and verifyTamperedFieldDetected
UserControllerIT: all 9 tests pass including tokenIsShownOnce (GET /users response has no token field)
AuthenticationServiceTest: all 5 @Tag("security") tests pass; 401 body is identical across all bad-auth scenarios
AuditIntegrityTest: all 3 @Tag("security") tests pass including deletedRecordIsDetected
CryptoServiceIT#tamperedStoredDekCausesDecryptionFailure: flipping a byte in wrapped_dek → 400 response
Total @Tag("security") test count is at least 1 per RBAC boundary (role × operation matrix covers all cells)
verification: cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode verify — BUILD SUCCESS, JaCoCo gate passes
cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode verify -Dgroups=security — all @Tag("security") tests pass (expect 25+ security tests)
cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode test -Dtest=AuditControllerIT — all tests pass
cd g:\hsm && mvn --batch-mode test -Dtest=UserControllerIT — all tests pass
